Inline math is $T_r = T/T_c$. Display math is numbered and referenceable:

$$
P = \frac{RT}{\Vm - b} - \frac{a\,\alpha(T_r)}{\Vm^2 + 2b\Vm - b^2}
$$ {#eq-pr}

@eq-pr is the Peng-Robinson form. Chemistry works too: $\ce{CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O}$.

```{python}
#| label: fig-example
#| fig-cap: "Caption goes here."
#| echo: false

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.plot([1, 2, 3], [1, 4, 9])
plt.xlabel("T (K)")
plt.ylabel("P (bar)")
plt.show()
```
